rachel: Shared postmortem link https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2390012345. Need tight owners for follow-ups: token validation, perms cleanup, audit backfill, secrets rota. Please claim and add a 1-line smoke check.

owen: I'll own token validation tests + TTL policy enforcement. Will add a CI guard that fails if TTLs differ more than 5s. ETA: 2026-04-04. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_ttl.py -q`

nate: Taking permissions cleanup and rollback-proofing (remove emergency wide binds, add regression test). ETA: 2026-04-08. Smoke: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding | grep svc-`

priya: I'll do audit ingestion gap analysis and run a targeted backfill for missing Authenticate entries (48h window). ETA backfill: 2026-03-31; validator in infra PR by 2026-04-05. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName="Authenticate" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)`

s-bot: Created ticket SEC-1234: "Postmortem follow-ups: authz". Claimed: token-guard (owen), perms-cleanup (nate), audit-backfill (priya). Recurrence: weekly drift scan (cron: 0 10 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1234

rachel: Consolidated checklist (put updates in SEC-1234):
- [ ] Token TTL guard + unit tests  
 owner: owen  
 due: 2026-04-04
- [ ] Permissions cleanup + regression test  
 owner: nate  
 due: 2026-04-08
- [ ] Audit backfill + schema validator  
 owner: priya  
 due: 2026-03-31/backfill, 2026-04-05/validator
- [ ] Runbook smoke snippets added  
 owners: owen/nate/priya  
 due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert on TTL drift, missing Authenticate events)

owen: Pushing TTL guard PR shortly. Will include a one-line verify command for runbook.

nate: Starting inventory now. Will post RBAC diff in the ticket.

priya: Kicking off small-staging backfill this afternoon, will escalate if we hit >5% bad payloads.

rachel: Thanks team. We'll review SEC-1234 in the security sync next Tue. If blockers, ping #eng-oncall and cc me. :thumbsup:
